title: When the Terminal Falls Again
premise: Jonah Oyelaran, sole caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the supply route between worlds that cut contact decades ago. When the ship Meridian returns from deep space with its entire crew aged backward and no memory of their voyage, Jonah discovers the only survivor who remembers: her former lover, Captain Adaeze Nwosu, who insists their expedition witnessed a massacre at the colony of Halcyon Reach — a massacre every archive, including Jonah's own vault records, says never happened. As the Meridian's failing reactor counts toward meltdown and the authorities move to erase Adaeze's testimony, Jonah must choose between the loyalty that once bound them and the truth that could reignite a war. In the end, Jonah broadcasts the vault's hidden original records at the cost of her post and nearly her life, proving the massacre real, saving Adaeze, and accepting that some loves survive only after everything else burns.
about_author: Sebastian Villalobos is a former logistics coordinator for polar research stations who turned to science fiction after a decade of maintaining systems no one remembered how to build. He writes about people who keep things running at the edge of the map.

chapters.title: The Long Route
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. She pilots the seed vault's aging courier between silent colonies, cataloguing what Earth abandoned. The routine is lonely but hers. Emotional beat: quiet devotion masking a grief she won't name — the lover who left on the Meridian nine years ago.

chapters.title: A Ship That Shouldn't Be
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. Docking at Relay Station Kestrel, she watches the long-lost Meridian drift in, hull scarred, transponder dead. The crew disembarks — young, unlined, nine years younger than when they left. Emotional beat: uncanny dread sharpening into recognition when she sees Adaeze's face.

chapters.title: Adaeze, Aged Backward
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. Adaeze doesn't remember Jonah, their history, or the voyage's final year — but she remembers Halcyon Reach burning. Station officials confiscate her logs within hours. Emotional beat: love colliding with the vertigo of being forgotten by the one who mattered most.

chapters.title: Records That Lie
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. She cross-checks the vault's archive: Halcyon Reach's massacre is absent, its colony logs pristine, its population listed as thriving. Someone has edited the deepest records — records only she can access. Emotional beat: the caretaker's faith in her own vault begins to crack.

chapters.title: The Reactor Countdown
chapters.summary: Adaeze's POV. Confined to quarantine, Adaeze discovers the Meridian's reactor is failing on a cascading countdown — sabotage or damage from whatever happened out there. She has maybe three weeks. Emotional beat: urgency and the humiliating fog of a memory that keeps slipping.

chapters.title: What the Crew Won't Say
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. The de-aged crew members parrot identical, rehearsed testimony: uneventful voyage, no Halcyon Reach contact. But one engineer, Tomas, flinches at Jonah's questions. Emotional beat: the horror of watching truth being surgically removed from living minds.

chapters.title: The Vault Below
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. Jonah descends into the vault's sealed sublevels and finds a physical backup core — pre-digital, un-editable — that her predecessor locked with a warning: some records are archived to be forgotten. Emotional beat: inheritance as burden; she realizes her job was always also a watch.

chapters.title: Fragments in Quarantine
chapters.summary: Adaeze's POV. Under Jonah's smuggled visits, Adaeze's memories surface in shards — a corridor, a scream, a fleet insignia that officially doesn't exist. She begins writing everything down before it fades. Emotional beat: two people rebuilding intimacy from opposite sides of a wall.

chapters.title: The Inspector Arrives
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. Inspector Corvane of the Colonial Authority arrives to 'assist' with the Meridian, charming and absolute, declaring the crew's testimony closed. He requests the vault's Halcyon Reach files — and Jonah must decide what to show him. Emotional beat: the first open move in a game of erasure.

chapters.title: Tomas Breaks
chapters.summary: Adaeze's POV. Engineer Tomas, haunted by fragments, secretly confirms it: they witnessed the Halcyon Reach colony destroyed by an Authority fleet, and the crew's memories were rewritten en route home. He begs Adaeze to let it go. Emotional beat: terror of a man who knows and wishes he didn't.

chapters.title: Nine Years of Silence
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. Jonah and Adaeze argue — why did Adaeze leave without goodbye, why did the worlds stop speaking, who ordered the blackout? Old wounds reopen. Emotional beat: love against duty made personal; they were both loyal to things that lied to them.

chapters.title: The Edited Vault
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. Corvane's team audits the vault and Jonah watches her own logs rewritten in real time, her caretaker credentials suspended. The physical core is now the only truth left. Emotional beat: violation — her sanctuary turned into a crime scene.

chapters.title: Countdown Accelerates
chapters.summary: Adaeze's POV. The Meridian's reactor drops to a two-week countdown; the Authority plans to scuttle the ship with the crew aboard, calling it containment. Adaeze realizes the reactor evidence itself proves tampering. Emotional beat: the clock becomes the story's spine.

chapters.title: Alliance of the Forgotten
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Jonah, Adaeze, and Tomas recruit the de-aged crew's youngest member, Ila, whose memory rewrite partially failed. Together they map what really happened at Halcyon Reach. Emotional beat: fragile solidarity among people the system has discarded.

chapters.title: The Physical Core
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. The team breaches the sealed sublevel and opens the core: raw telemetry, fleet orders, and footage of the massacre — including the signature of the officer who gave the order. Emotional beat: triumph curdling instantly, because the signature belongs to Corvane's chain of command.

chapters.title: Betrayal at Kestrel
chapters.summary: Adaeze's POV. Ila, terrified, alerts the Authority. Corvane seals the station, arrests Adaeze, and orders the Meridian scuttled early. Jonah escapes with the core data into the vault's maintenance tunnels. Emotional beat: betrayal by the weakest link, and the cost of mercy.

chapters.title: The Long Route, Run Backward
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. Jonah takes the vault's ancient courier through unmapped relay corridors — the same route she's flown for years — to reach the broadcast array at Deep Relay Nine before Corvane's jamming grid closes. Emotional beat: her mundane mastery of a dying route becomes the only path to truth.

chapters.title: What Corvane Wants
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV (first antagonist chapter). Corvane believes the massacre was a necessary cull to prevent a colony plague from reaching Earth, and that forgetting is mercy. He offers Jonah full restoration if she surrender the core. Emotional beat: an antagonist who is almost right, which is worse.

chapters.title: The Broadcast
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV. At Deep Relay Nine, under jamming fire and with the reactor countdown at forty hours, Jonah transmits the massacre records on every open channel — and the silent colonies, one by one, begin to answer. Emotional beat: the loneliest job in the system finally heard by everyone.

chapters.title: Meltdown at Kestrel
chapters.summary: Adaeze's POV. Adaeze breaks free during the broadcast's chaos and races to the Meridian, choosing to vent the reactor manually rather than let the Authority scuttle the crew. Emotional beat: duty inverted — she saves the people she was ordered to contain.

chapters.title: Terminal Fall
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. The Meridian's reactor falls; Adaeze vents it at the edge of survivability, Jonah flies through the debris field to pull the crew out. Corvane is arrested by his own fleet when the broadcast reaches Earth. Emotional beat: climax — everything risked, everything nearly lost, love proven in action.

chapters.title: Seeds in Open Ground
chapters.summary: Jonah's POV, weeks later. The colonies reopen contact; the vault becomes a public archive instead of a sealed one. Adaeze, memories still patchy, asks to start over — not to recover what was, but to grow something new. Emotional beat: resolution — memory restored, loyalty redefined, love chosen freely.
